question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Alacrity
solution:
The correct answer is: **Willingness**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Alacrity**: A quick and cheerful readiness to do something. (उत्साह) 

 
 
• For example- *She accepted the invitation with alacrity.*
 
 
 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given words in the options section.
 
 
• **Willingness**: The quality of being happy to do something if it is needed. (इच्छा)
 
 
• For example- *We admire her willingness to stand up for what she believes.*
 
 
 
• **Mediocrity**: The quality of being average or ordinary. (सामान्यता)
 
• **Capriciousness**: The quality of changing mood or behaviour suddenly and unexpectedly. (मनमौजीपन)
 
• **Pleasure**: A pleased feeling; enjoyment; delight; satisfaction. (प्रसन्नता)
 
 
 
• From the meaning of the given words, it is clear that the most appropriate synonym of 'Alacrity' is 'Willingness'.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.
